title: Bixafen-induced immunotoxicity in zebrafish: TLR4/NF-kappaB activation and DNA replication disruption as critical pathways.
authors: Fang, Fei; Peng, Bo; Zhu, Yanjuan; Xu, Wenping; Zhang, Yang; Cheng, Jiagao
one_liner_zh: 研究杀菌剂Bixafen对斑马鱼的免疫毒性，涉及TLR4/NF-kB通路和DNA复制干扰，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Comprehensive understanding the toxic effects of pesticide with relative long half-life properties are always hot research topics in the world. In this study, the immunotoxic effects of Bixafen (BIX), a prominent Succinate Dehydrogenase Inhibitor (SDHI) fungicide, were systematically assessed at concentrations of 0.05, 0.1, and 0.2 muM, using a zebrafish (Danio rerio) larval model. Neutral red staining and confocal microscopy quantification showed that BIX exposure reduced immune cell numbers in a concentration-dependent manner. qPCR and Western blot validation revealed upregulated pro-inflammatory factors (IL-1beta, IL-8, TNF-alpha) and TLR4 gene expression, while the lymphocyte marker gene rag1 was downregulated. Protein - level detection found significantly increased p-p65/p65 and TLR4 expression. Molecular docking experiments showed that BIX forms multiple interactions with the TLR4 protein. RNA-Seq analysis further confirmed that BIX interferes with DNA replication and metabolic pathways. Our results suggest that BIX may activate proinflammatory responses and disrupt immune cell homeostasis via the TLR4 signaling pathway, posing a potential immunotoxicity risk to non-target organisms. These findings provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of BIX-induced immunotoxicity and are critical for assessing the environmental safety and health risks associated with SDHI fungicides.
abstract_zh: 全面理解具有相对较长半衰期特性的农药的毒性效应一直是全球研究热点。本研究以斑马鱼（Danio rerio）幼鱼模型，系统评估了琥珀酸脱氢酶抑制剂（SDHI）类杀菌剂氟吡菌酰胺（Bixafen, BIX）在0.05、0.1和0.2 μM浓度下的免疫毒性效应。中性红染色和共聚焦显微镜定量分析显示，BIX暴露以浓度依赖性方式减少免疫细胞数量。qPCR和Western blot验证揭示促炎因子（IL-1β、IL-8、TNF-α）及TLR4基因表达上调，而淋巴细胞标志基因rag1下调。蛋白水平检测发现p-p65/p65和TLR4表达显著增加。分子对接实验表明，BIX与TLR4蛋白形成多种相互作用。RNA-Seq分析进一步证实BIX干扰DNA复制和代谢通路。我们的结果表明，BIX可能通过TLR4信号通路激活促炎反应并破坏免疫细胞稳态，对非靶标生物构成潜在免疫毒性风险。这些发现为BIX诱导免疫毒性的分子机制提供了见解，对评估SDHI类杀菌剂的环境安全性和健康风险至关重要。
